title: Dungeon defense, with offline and idle elements, finally released.
author: k6ga
selftext:
After months of development, and many more weeks of beta testing **Rushfall** is now out on Web & Android (for **free**, no ads or micro purchases).   
Web: [https://rushfall.com](https://rushfall.com)  
Android: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rushfall.game](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rushfall.game)

I've been coding games or working on private servers for almost as long as I can remember, but the hurdle of hiring artists for assets was always too much of a barrier. Now with the help of AI that barrier has been lifted and I am finally able to release my first game! 

It's art is rendered from code and sound as well. The game runs on a Typescript base, with PIXI engine and Capacitator to turn it into an Android/iOS app. Built mostly with Opus 5.5 and a little Fable, but results were mixed with the latter. Backend runs on AWS with lambda's for the API, DynamoDB table for profiles, accounts, boards, presence, online pings and feedback. An S3 bucket holds blobs (kept saves, battle logs), and telemetry.

Besides the game, there's also extensive simulations built for all different classes, playstyles (tower vs hero), items, town building, etc. Was quite a challenge to get the simulations to run fast enough to reach deep endgame but rewarding all the same. 

I'm still actively developing and any feedback is always welcome! 

Thanks.
